fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-02-09, the complainant left a blue scooter bearing registration number TN-01-ZZ-1068 near Mullai Colony Shopping Complex and could not find it later. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-02-09 at roughly 03:35. The complainant, Ramya Bai, provided the contact number 9000000232. The complainant alleged that Madhan Murugan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000216. A witness, Kishore Selvam, reachable on 9000000323, was mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00323, as the mobile number 9000000216 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly taken after the handle lock was forced.
fields.Keywords: scooter theft, vehicle, suspect, mobile number, photograph, shopping complex, scooter, night
